Class NavigationView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
net.tessel.fx.components.NavigationView
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class NavigationView extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
The main navigation of an app: a pane of items on the left (collapsible to an icon rail) and the selected page next to it. Pages are created lazily, the first time their item is selected, and cached. 
NavigationView nav = new NavigationView("My App");
nav.setPaneHeader(searchField);
nav.addItem("Home", Symbol.HOME, HomePage::new);
nav.addHeader("Section");
nav.addFooterItem("Settings", Symbol.SETTINGS, SettingsPage::new);
nav.select(0);
The pane collapses to a rail by itself when the view gets narrower than autoCompactWidthProperty(), and the button in the top bar toggles it.
